text.이 플랫폼이 Agent SDK로 실행할 때 받은 사용량 한도 이벤트의 창: Latest value per window of the usage limit events this platform received while running with the Agent SDK. Updated only by runs with a subscription sign-in; the usage rate can be empty before the warning threshold.
text.사용량 한도 값을 담은 실행 기록 이벤트 이름입니다. 보통은 바꾸지 않습: Name of the run history event that holds usage limit values. You usually don't change this.
text.최근 기록을 몇 개까지 거슬러 볼지입니다. 늘리면 오래된 값도 찾지만 느: How many recent records to look back through. Raising it finds older values too but is slower.
text.설정할 것이 없습니다. 구독 로그인으로 에이전트를 실행하면 값이 생깁니다: Nothing to set up. Values appear when you run agents with a subscription sign-in. Runs with API key authentication don't have 5-hour and weekly windows.
text.대화형 Claude Code가 statusLine 명령에 넘기는 사용량(: Usage (5-hour and 7-day usage rates) that interactive Claude Code passes to the statusLine command, saved to a file by `agent-console statusline`. Only available with a Pro/Max subscription, after the first reply of a session.
text.상태 줄 브리지가 쓰는 파일입니다. 상대 경로면 작업 공간의 .state: File the status line bridge writes. A relative path is resolved from the workspace's .state folder.

text.이 프로그램은 `~/.claude` 설정을 고치지 않습니다. 아래 조각: This program doesn't change your `~/.claude` settings. Paste one of the snippets below yourself. Values appear with a Pro/Max subscription after the first reply of a session, and each window can be missing on its own. If you already save the status line input to a file (e.g. `echo "$input" > file`), you can instead put that file's absolute path in this source's `path` setting.
